overview: White fianchettoes the king's bishop to hit the long diagonal, putting pressure on d5, c4 and b7 and keeping a slight positional edge. After 3...d5 4.Nf3 Black chooses the Open Catalan (...dxc4) or Closed Catalan (...Be7, ...O-O, ...c6). White presses with queen's knight, Qc2 and rooks on the c-file and queenside while Black aims to equalise by playing ...c5 or ...b5. The game is a slow positional squeeze.

white_ideas.idea: Bg2 long-diagonal pressure on d5 and b7, with Qc2 and Nbd2 or Nc3
Recover c4 in the Open Catalan and keep a small pull on the queenside
Wait for ...c6 or ...b6 to be answered with a central break

black_ideas.idea: Closed Catalan: ...Be7, ...O-O, ...c6 and ...Nbd7, solid and hard to break
Open Catalan: take c4, hold with ...a6 and ...b5 or return the pawn
Break with ...c5 or ...e5 to release the pressure

typical_structures.structure: White fianchetto against Black solid d5/e6/c6 chain (Closed Catalan)
Open Catalan with c4 pawn taken, White regaining it with the bishop pair pressure

character.notes: Positional pressure with little immediate danger for either side; steady, hard for Black to break the long diagonal pressure but also hard for White to win.

gambit.notes: Black takes c4 but White wins it back, so not a gambit.

soundness.notes: Sound; played at the highest level.

structure.notes: Tension in the centre, c4/d4 against d5, so Flexible.

approach.notes: A mainstream White opening and a standard choice, not a pure system.

level.notes: Plans are subtle with long diagonal squeezes; theory manageable, but understanding matters.

sublines_that_differ.name: Open Catalan
sublines_that_differ.how: Black takes the pawn and White regains it, giving a more open and concrete game.

sublines_that_differ.name: Catalan with Bb4+
sublines_that_differ.how: Black checks first to trade a bishop and ease the pressure.

character.reason: Slow positional pressure, neither sharp nor especially hard to crack.

structure.reason: Centre in tension, fianchetto flank play.

approach.reason: A mainstream choice, although the set-up works against many defences.

level.reason: The squeeze plans take understanding more than memory.

plans.reason: A long-diagonal bishop and pressure on the queenside.
